anode_cathode_crosser.comment: Tracks with collection-plane time-span inside this tight window around 2575 ticks (FWHM-above-background) are flagged anode-cathode crossers.

intime_anode_crosser.comment: Tracks with earliest collection-plane hit time inside this tight window around the anode tick (FWHM-above-background) are flagged in-time anode crossers.
